from AlgorithmImports import *


class ParallelStrategyTemplateAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](101)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.aapl_previous_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        # Market-state quantities continue updating whenever their own bars exist.
        if self.spy in data.Bars:
            self.spy_closes.Add(data.Bars[self.spy].Close)

        if self.aapl in data.Bars:
            aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close
            self.aapl_rsi.Update(data.Bars[self.aapl].EndTime, aapl_close)

            if self.aapl_previous_close is not None and aapl_close < self.aapl_previous_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.aapl_previous_close = aapl_close

        # Skip all rule evaluation if any subscribed ticker is missing today.
        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        # Do not trade until all rule inputs are fully formed.
        if not self.spy_closes.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

        current_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(100)) / 100.0
        previous_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(1, 101)) / 100.0
        previous_spy_close = self.spy_closes[1]

        upward_sma_cross = (
            previous_spy_close <= previous_sma and
            spy_close > current_sma
        )
        downward_sma_cross = (
            previous_spy_close >= previous_sma and
            spy_close < current_sma
        )

        # Sells before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and downward_sma_cross:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
            self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and upward_sma_cross:
            shares = int((0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) // spy_close)
            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = shares

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                shares = int(20_000 // aapl_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = shares

from AlgorithmImports import *


class IndependentSlotsStrategy(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]:
            self.symbols[ticker] = self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](101)
        self.aapl_closes = RollingWindow[float](4)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols.values()):
            return

        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

        self.spy_closes.Add(float(spy_bar.Close))
        self.aapl_closes.Add(float(aapl_bar.Close))
        self.aapl_rsi.Update(self.Time, aapl_bar.Close)

        if not (self.spy_closes.IsReady and self.aapl_closes.IsReady and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady):
            return

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0:
            spy_sma_today = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(100)) / 100.0
            spy_sma_yesterday = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(1, 101)) / 100.0

            if self.spy_closes[0] < spy_sma_today and self.spy_closes[1] >= spy_sma_yesterday:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
                self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0:
            spy_sma_today = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(100)) / 100.0
            spy_sma_yesterday = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(1, 101)) / 100.0

            if self.spy_closes[0] > spy_sma_today and self.spy_closes[1] <= spy_sma_yesterday:
                quantity = int((0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue)) / float(spy_bar.Close))
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0:
            red_three_days = (
                self.aapl_closes[0] < self.aapl_closes[1]
                and self.aapl_closes[1] < self.aapl_closes[2]
                and self.aapl_closes[2] < self.aapl_closes[3]
            )

            if red_three_days and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                quantity = int(20000 / float(aapl_bar.Close))
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

            self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        ]

        self.spy = self.symbols[0]
        self.aapl = self.symbols[1]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.SetWarmUp(101, Resolution.Daily)

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy] if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy) else None
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl] if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl) else None

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None and aapl_bar.Close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        all_bars_present = all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols)

        if (
            not self.IsWarmingUp
            and all_bars_present
            and self.spy_sma.IsReady
            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
        ):
            current_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            spy_crossed_up = (
                self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_bar.Close > current_spy_sma
            )
            spy_crossed_down = (
                self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_bar.Close < current_spy_sma
            )

            # Sells before buys.
            if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_crossed_down:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
                self.strategy_a_lot = 0

            if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
                self.strategy_b_lot = 0

            if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_crossed_up:
                quantity = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / spy_bar.Close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

            if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
                cash = self.Portfolio.CashBook[self.AccountCurrency].Amount
                if cash >= 20_000:
                    quantity = int(20_000 / aapl_bar.Close)
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                        self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        if spy_bar is not None:
            self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
            if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
                self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

class IndependentStrategySlotsAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.symbols = [
            self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        ]

        self.spy = self.Symbol("SPY")
        self.aapl = self.Symbol("AAPL")

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](101)
        self.aapl_closes = RollingWindow[float](4)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        # Keep market-state calculations current for each ticker that has a bar.
        if self.spy in data.Bars:
            self.spy_closes.Add(float(data.Bars[self.spy].Close))

        if self.aapl in data.Bars:
            aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]
            self.aapl_closes.Add(float(aapl_bar.Close))
            self.aapl_rsi.Update(
                IndicatorDataPoint(self.aapl, aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)
            )

        # Do not evaluate any strategy rule unless every subscription has today's bar.
        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

        # Evaluate all sells before any buys.
        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and self.spy_closes.IsReady:
            sma_today = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(100)) / 100.0
            sma_yesterday = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(1, 101)) / 100.0

            downward_cross = (
                self.spy_closes[1] >= sma_yesterday and
                self.spy_closes[0] < sma_today
            )

            if downward_cross:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            if self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and self.spy_closes.IsReady:

            upward_cross = (
                self.spy_closes[1] <= sma_yesterday and
                self.spy_closes[0] > sma_today
            )

            if upward_cross:
                quantity = int(
                    (0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue)) /
                    float(spy_bar.Close)
                )

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self.aapl_closes.IsReady:
            three_consecutive_red_days = (
                self.aapl_closes[0] < self.aapl_closes[1] and

                self.aapl_closes[2] < self.aapl_closes[3]
            )

            if three_consecutive_red_days and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                quantity = int(20000 / float(aapl_bar.Close))

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = quantity
